headline: India Shelter Finance updates compliance officer and RTA details
hook: Routine compliance filing from India Shelter
summary: India Shelter Finance Corporation has submitted updates regarding its compliance officer and Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) to the stock exchange. This is a routine corporate governance filing required by regulatory norms. No financial impact or operational changes are signaled by this disclosure. Indian retail shareholders need take no specific action.
why_it_matters: No impact on share price or fundamental value.
